system.longDesc: Between the quick and the dead, you tend toward the former.

degree0.desc: You are deadlier when you’re closer. You gain a +1 bonus to damage with pistols against targets within 6 yards.

degree1.desc: Your weapon’s small size helps you respond quickly to threats. You can roll your initiative with an Accuracy (Pistols) test instead of a Dexterity (Initiative) test if you have a pistol in your hand, or if it’s holstered and you draw it as your first action. You can generate stunt points with this special test.

degree2.desc: Double-tap is the only way to be sure. When hitting a target with a pistol, you can add your Dexterity to the damage total. Each time you do this, the Capacity of your pistol (see when it returns to its normal value.
